We Are Customer Zero

Big news from SAPPHIRE: Joule Work Desktop is now GA for every SAP employee.

As Sebastian Steinhaeuser announced, we're not just launching an AI assistant — we're running it ourselves first, at full enterprise scale, with all the complexity that comes with a company of our size.

And here's what makes it even more significant: SAP is Customer Zero for both Joule Work Desktop and SAP Managed. Infrastructure, provisioning, updates, security, operations — all handled by SAP, exactly as they will be for our customers.

What This Means for PMMs

🎯 Credibility Boost

"We use it ourselves" is the strongest proof point you can have. When customers ask if SAP actually uses Joule — the answer is yes, at enterprise scale.

🔄 Real Feedback Loop

Product issues get surfaced fast when 100K+ employees are using it daily. Our internal experience directly improves what customers get.

📖 Story Material

Every SAP employee's experience with Joule is a potential customer story. Start using it, document your wins, share what works.
